Disappointed
Not one to write reviews but I ordered this screen protector to use on my iPhone 11 and on my mom's iPhone XR. I have used many different brands of iPhone screen protectors and never had an issue with application. I first followed the given directions to apply the screen protector to the iPhone XR and there was a flawless application. I then went to apply it to my iPhone 11. After following the given directions, the same way I did for the iPhone XR, the screen protector did not go on as flawless as the first time. After pressing the screen protector in the middle of the screen once it is fitted to the screen, I was left with a large air bubble on the top of the air protector. I used my finger to try to get the air bubble out and it did not work. A credit card also did not work to remove the air bubble. It was just moving the bubble to the surrounding areas. Since this box came with 3 screen protectors, I took this screen protector off and I now had one last chance to get it right. During the final application, once again following the directions for a second time on my iPhone 11, the same problem occurred, but now the air bubble was on the lower portion of the screen (see image). Extremely disappointed because only 1/3 screen protectors were successful, none of which were for the iPhone 11. Will not purchase again.
